messages.author: 71bfb5f1e96782a8
messages.subject: theta_lim & EAPsum
parts:
Hi Phil,

i use fscores(..., method = "EAPsum") to get theta estimates for each sum score. however, at theta = 4 there is little increase in theta when the sum score increases and i suspect it is impossible for the estimate to go beyond 4. i tried to adjust with the theta_lim argument but the estimation seems uninfluenced by that (even if i narrow the band to theta = c(-1,1) the expected thetas are the same). I guess, EAPsum just doesn't take theta_lim into account, could you look into that?

Thanks a lot, best wishes, Felix

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: theta_lim & EAPsum
parts:
Hi Felix,

Thanks, you're right I missed this option when adding in the theta_lim option a while back. It's been added, and also will affect the itemfit() S_X2 statistics when theta_lim is passed. 

You've brought this fscores problem up a couple times now. I think in the next update I'll increase both the number of quadpts and the range of the theta grid to try to avoid these flooring effects in the default cases. Cheers.

Phil
